page2.text:
"..."
...That's weird.
What are they whispering about right in front of me?

page3.text:
"Tohsaka? Illya?"
...?
I can't raise my voice. Something must be wrong with my throat.
"Mm-hrm. One more time...
HEY! WHAT ARE YOU TWO TALKING ABOUT!?"

page4.text:
They suddenly stop whispering.
"Aah. Aah, aah?"
Oh, my voice is back.
It seems like yelling helped clear up my throat.

page5.text: "You were just talking about how my seasoning style was fresh and novel. Do you actually not like spicy food, Shirou?"

page6.text:
"Your food isn't spicy, it's numbing.
We already decided that Sakura would make lunch, so give it up already. Shirou said he prefers Sakura's stew, too."

page7.text:
Apparently, they were talking about lunch.
"Hey, this isn't really—"
"the time," I almost say.
I look at the clock and see that it's almost noon.

page8.text:
...
...Something nags at me.
Nothing's particularly wrong, but I feel a strange chill in the familiar dojo.
Because

forty, then twenty-six times

page10.text:
...
I tap a finger on my forehead.
I'm okay.
Anyway, the dizziness is going away.

page11.text:
"Shirou? You said you were going shopping with Illya, right?"
I search my memory.
I frown for a bit before remembering that I did say I'd go shopping with Illya.

page12.text:
"Yeah. Let's go, Illya."
I shake my head and start walking.
"...Hang on. What's wrong with you? You seemed fine when we put the shroud back on, but do you feel tired now?"

page13.text: "Hm? Uh... Yeah, I feel a little confused. But it's no big deal."
